tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List open-source agent templates when the user asks for a reusable prompt, workflow or job template, or wants them filtered by department or keyword. Returns name, path and license status (free or restricted). Read-only, no authentication required.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Fetch one template by its path (as returned by list_templates) and get its full prompt text when the licence allows it.
